what: LANDED, UNPROVEN: #13047 (merged 2026-09-27 ~09:37Z) sends Alpaca bracket/OTO entries as time_in_force gtc instead of day, so protective legs survive the RTH close. The claim that Alpaca accepts a GTC market-entry bracket rests on docs.alpaca.markets/docs/orders-at-alpaca (read 2026-09-27), NOT on a live order. If the venue refuses the TIF, place() re-sends once as day and logs 're-sending as DAY' (pre-change behaviour, legs lapse at the close). Closes when the first post-deploy Alpaca bracket entry is observed with GTC legs; kill with the refusal text if the fallback fires instead.
